title: OpenTelemetry exports to a public endpoint
explanation: An OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_*ENDPOINT variable points at a public host, so traces, metrics or logs are exported outside the network.

evidence.detail: image env OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT points at public host otlp.observability-vendor.example.com

fix: Point the OTLP endpoint at a collector inside the enclave.
